productFit.name: HOOBS Box (HSLF-3)
productFit.variant: HOOBS Box HSLF-3 bought from the HOOBS shop (hoobs.com) with the 'Power Adapter' option set to EU-Plug (the shop also offers US-Plug, UK-Plug and USB-Cable Only). HOOBS says all EU orders ship from its Warehouse Germany, about 3 business days. The box itself is USB-C powered (5 V, up to 3 A), so only the plug adapter differs.
productFit.reason: HOOBS lists an EU-Plug adapter choice on the HSLF-3 product page and ships EU orders from Germany, so it is sold to DE/ES/NL. HOOBS prices are ex-VAT with customs/taxes the buyer's responsibility, per its shipping page. No ASIN or Amazon DE/ES/NL listing was confirmed (the English brief also notes the Amazon US listing is unconfirmed), so the localized post should point to hoobs.com and the EU-Plug option, not an amzn search. Not verified: whether Ring Alarm and the listed tested Ring accessories are the same hardware sold in the EU; the post should say the plugin works with the Ring account/cloud and the reader's own Ring devices.

localFacts.fact: AEPD says cameras in a community of owners may only be installed in common areas and may not capture the public road except a minimal strip needed for access; it publishes a guide on video cameras.

AEPD FAQ on video door entry systems: data protection rules do not apply to processing by individuals for exclusively personal or household activities (the AEPD text goes on to set limits; read the full FAQ before relying on it).

CAF Madrid (college of property administrators) reports the Tribunal Supremo found that an electronic peephole violated neighbours' privacy because it activated whenever someone came to a neighbour's door and viewing was constant; sources note digital peepholes that only show or record when the bell is pressed are treated differently. Court-specific; general information only.
AEPD guide on video cameras for security and other purposes (AEPD publication) is the official reference for signage and image-retention points.
HOOBS ships EU orders from its German warehouse in about 3 business days with an EU-Plug adapter option; customs and taxes are the buyer's responsibility, per HOOBS.

Not covered: OCU/FACUA or Spanish tenancy-law (LAU) guidance on tenant works needing the landlord's consent was not found in this research; the post should simply tell readers to read their contract and ask the landlord in writing, without citing a rule.

localPainPoints.pain: Renters ask whether a camera doorbell or digital peephole on the flat door is legal when it can see the landing and neighbours.
localPainPoints.fix: Local fact: CAF Madrid on the Supreme Court peephole ruling and AEPD common-area guidance; choose a doorbell that only shows or records when pressed, aim it only at your own door, and ask the landlord first.
